title: Book Two · Chapter 4: Read It Again
story:
On Thursday, Miss Wu puts a little box on the front desk.

“Two minutes for our note game,” she says. “Then we will open our number books.”

Leo sits up straight. Ronan puts his hands on his knees. Today he will wait for the whole note.

Miss Wu writes two lines on the board.

Take the small blue square.

Leave the big blue square in the box.

She shows the class both pieces. A girl reads the first line. A boy takes the small square. Then he holds it up.

“Good,” Miss Wu says. “Put it back.”

Ronan watches the square go into the box. There are two blue pieces again.

“Ronan. Your turn.”

He goes to the front. From here, the two squares look almost the same size. One corner is under a red card.

He starts to reach for it. Then he stops.

“May I move the red card?”

“Yes.”

He moves it aside. Now he can see both blue squares clearly. He reads the first line again and takes the smaller one.

Miss Wu gives him a new line on a card.

Put this square behind the box.

He reads it silently. Then he walks to the other side of the desk and puts the square down.

From his seat, Leo cannot see it.

“You lost it,” Leo calls.

“It is behind the box.”

“Then you can get it back,” Miss Wu says.

Ronan picks it up. He turns it between his fingers. This time he did not copy the child before him. The line was new, and he read it himself.

He goes back to his seat.

Leo holds up one hand under the desk. Ronan touches it with his own. It makes a small flat sound.

Miss Wu opens a number book.

“Now put the game away.”

Ronan helps collect the cards. Then he reads the first number problem with Leo. Their answers are different. They go back to the same line and count again. Leo finds the missing two.

At lunch, Jun comes to see the tiny paper box on Ronan's desk. The sides stand up now.

“You fixed it,” Ronan says.

“I made the bottom wider.”

Jun puts one bean inside. The box holds it.

“Only one bean?” Leo asks.

“It is a small lunch.”

Ronan draws a spoon on a scrap of paper and lays it beside the box. The spoon is longer than the whole lunch.

Jun laughs and takes it home with the box.

After school, Ronan tells Mum about the blue square.

“I read the new line. I did not just remember the old one.”

Mum is putting a button on a shirt. She looks up.

“And did you enjoy the game?”

“Yes.”

“Good.”

He waits for another question, but she goes back to the button. He takes out his book and sits near her.

A little later, he holds up the page.

“Can I read this bit to you?”

Mum moves the shirt away from the edge.

“Go on. I can listen while I sew.”
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

silently＝不出声地；behind＝在后面；bottom＝底部；button＝纽扣。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan为什么先移动红卡片？
2. 这次新任务和记住旧答案有什么区别？

## 读句子

He / moves it aside.＝他／把它移到一旁。
